title: {Syn} Raft Made Consensus Easier to Teach
content:
Raft is a consensus algorithm designed to be understandable while solving the same core replicated-log problem as Paxos. It separates leader election, log replication, and safety.

Consensus matters because distributed systems need several machines to agree on state even when some messages are delayed or nodes fail.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
